name: EfficientNetB0 fine-tuned (binary)
task: Brain MRI: tumor vs no tumor

input.name: image
input.format: RGB pixels 0-255, resized to 224x224, no normalization (the model scales internally)

output.name: tumor_probability
output.meaning: probability that the scan contains a tumor

threshold_note: Chosen on the validation set to catch at least 98% of tumors (capped at 0.5)
